summary: Park County, MT treated-timber R-6 tower dated 1955 on the Gallatin National Forest; listed as gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as Gone by firelookout.com and by the Forest Fire Lookout Association

events.note: Listing gives 1955 with the tower description; read as the build year
Listing carries an 'Emergency 1969' entry with no explanation

evidence.supports: tower dated 1955 and described as a 20-foot treated timber R-6 tower

evidence.quote: 1955: 20' treated timber R-6 tower. Emergency 1969. Gone.

evidence.supports: Rex's page places the site in the Gallatin National Forest
Forest Fire Lookout Association coordinates 45.09569, -110.22535 and status Tower Gone
another Lookout Mountain exists in Ravalli County, so the county is needed to tell sites apart

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief carried two coordinate sets for this tower. The Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives 45.09569, -110.22535, which the record keeps. The pages read do not settle the other set (45.09522, -110.2188).

notes_for_editor: The 20' in the listing is kept as the listing's own wording; height_m is null because the listing does not say whether 20' is the tower's height or its base size. The 1955 date is read as the build year from the listing's layout. The 1969 'Emergency' entry is unexplained in every source read, so it is logged as other. No staffing, fire history or site-today description was found in two searches; the story is short for that reason. Brief's two coordinate sets are noted in resolved_conflicts.
